file_specs.records: SYNTHETIC campaign records (each carries evidence_status 'SYNTHETIC_TEST_ONLY_NOT_EVIDENCE'; never evidence): for every expected key of the committed manifest, in expected_keys order, {key, mode: manifest mode, smoke: false, prereg_lock_sha256: manifest value, hallthruster_commit: the repository pin, retcode: 'success', evidence_status}; then the mutations in order: [drop, i] removes record i, [duplicate, i] appends a copy of record i, [unexpected, i, key] appends a copy of record i with that key, [set, i, field, value], [del, i, field], [retcode, i, value], [retcode_drop, i] deletes retcode, [keep_none] removes all, [blank_lines] marks the set; then written as JSONL (json.dumps(record) + newline) into `files` files s0.jsonl .. s{files-1}.jsonl, record r (after mutations) into file r % files, and with [blank_lines] an empty line and a line of two spaces written before every record whose index is a multiple of 50; `files` 0 writes nothing

steps.launch_spec: ok = {program, args, cwd, env, env_clear}: Rust = the JobSpec's std::process::Command (get_program, get_args, get_current_dir, get_envs) without spawning; reference = argv from the committed manifest command (campaign) or the julia-smoke.yml command (smoke), cwd = R, env = the allow-list projection of the parent environment (+ P5N2_SMOKE '1' for the smoke), env_clear true
steps.shard_partition: ok = [[shard, sorted keys] ...]; reference = the driver rule evaluated by the harness (no Python implementation exists; invariant, see INV-02)
steps.check: check(json.load(committed manifest), sorted(T/rec/*.jsonl) + extra_paths) with the module global BR = bridge (null = repository bridge); ok = the returned dict
steps.pin: bridge = root/hallthruster_bridge; ok = {commit, version, julia_version, manifest_consistent, pinned_constants}: reference commit / version from tomllib PINNED.toml ['hallthruster'] and julia_version from Manifest.toml ['julia_version'] read first (julia-smoke.yml; an exception there is the step's err), then manifest_consistent = (ci_checks.check_hallthruster_pin(bridge) returns no problem and raises nothing), pinned_constants = (commit, version, julia_version) == the hall_physics_boundary pin; Rust: read_pin(root) for the three values, the admitted verifier check hallthruster_pin(root) for manifest_consistent, and verify_pin(root) succeeding iff manifest_consistent and pinned_constants (scored as a sixth field verify_pin_ok, reference = manifest_consistent and pinned_constants)

random_check_procedure.draw: for i in 0..47, tag t = f'RC|{i}': manifest = sorted manifest names[U(t|m) % 19]; records = one success record per expected key (expected_keys order), then k = U(t|k) % 4 mutations, mutation j of kind ['drop', 'duplicate', 'unexpected', 'mode', 'smoke', 'lock', 'commit', 'retcode'][U(t|j|kind) % 8] at record index U(t|j|idx) % len(records) (unexpected appends a record whose key is the chosen key with '|x' appended; mode sets 'facility' if the manifest mode is vacuum else 'vacuum'; smoke sets true; lock sets '0' * 64; commit sets '1' * 40; retcode sets 'failure'); records written in order to f = 1 + U(t|files) % 4 files, record r to file r % f
